accounting.cost_interpretation: Sum of nonnull library-reported total_cost estimates; not a provider invoice. Partial sums do not imply zero cost for unavailable receipts or fields.
accounting.reservation_interpretation: Reservations are conservative liability bounds, not spending.

condition: V10 plus shared project context and neutral locators/references; frozen 09G judge cores. Historical V6b scores are a different condition, not a causal prompt-only comparison.
denominators: All 24 scheduled answers retained, 12 per model and 2 per question/model. A pass means substantive, not correct classification against an independent route label. G answer pass requires every planned supporting/qualification point. Conditional G/S/C denominators require substantive A; skipped/unavailable/invalid answers are never joint passes. Strict diagnostic is schema-valid, citations resolved, complete coverage, substantive A and all G/S/C pass; official Task12 strict metric remains separate.
interpretation: Automated judged pass rates on six exposed development questions; not independently measured objective accuracy or a general model ranking.
limitations: Six exposed questions with two repeats per model, no general ranking.
Bundled new context and prompt condition; changes are not causally isolated.
Frozen judge outputs are not independently verified ground truth.
Counting billing remains unknown; usage costs are estimates, not invoices.
